atomic_facts.fact: The exact legal name of the company that operates the In-N-Out Burger restaurant chain is In-N-Out Burger, Inc.
In-N-Out Burger was founded by Harry and Esther Snyder.
In-N-Out Burger is headquartered in Irvine, California.
In-N-Out Burger is currently owned and controlled by Lynsi Snyder.
Searches covering 2020-01-01 through 2026-09-30 were conducted for criminal indictments, convictions, bankruptcy, regulator enforcement actions, and civil judgments exceeding $5 million.
No criminal convictions or indictments of In-N-Out Burger were identified for the period 2020-01-01 through 2026-09-30.
No bankruptcies, regulator enforcement actions, or civil judgments exceeding $5 million involving In-N-Out Burger were identified for the period 2020-01-01 through 2026-09-30.
